findings.description: Pinned snippet buttons call `ControllerAccessibilityService.instance?.typeText(pin.optString("text", ""))` directly without applying TextStyles.transform(). FloatingKeyboardOverlay (line 361) and AIInputMethodService (line 162) both apply TextStyles.transform() to pinned snippets, so this surface produces unstyled text for pins while others respect the active style mode.

currentMode() calls PttModeStore.load(this) on every invocation, hitting SharedPreferences disk I/O per keystroke. FloatingKeyboardOverlay caches the mode in a field (loaded once in show(), updated on style button changes). This is a performance regression for the IME path.

Enter key calls `typeCharacter("\n")` which injects a literal newline. FloatingKeyboardOverlay calls `service.pressEnter()` which first tries ACTION_IME_ENTER (triggering search/send/go on single-line fields) and only falls back to newline. KeyboardActivity's Enter key won't submit forms/searches on single-line fields.

REV=3 migration (lines 70-78) discards ALL user-customized button mappings from legacy profiles (rev < 3), keeping only tuning values (sensitivity/deadzone/cursor/invert). This is a breaking data-loss change for existing users. User acknowledged as acceptable for AntiMicroX parity, but should be explicitly documented in release notes.

testing_summary: Build compiles successfully (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin). No test suite exists in this port yet per AGENTS.md.
risk_rationale: Three auto-fixable correctness/performance issues in keyboard surfaces (pinned snippet styling, per-keystroke SharedPreferences I/O, Enter key behavior) plus one acknowledged breaking data migration. All are localized and fixable without architectural changes.
